tool_calls.literal:
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md
jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"action:\"))), (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"strategy:\"))), (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"subtask:\")))]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{a["'$2]+=$1;s[$3]+=$1;u[$4]+=$1} END {for(k in a) print "ACTION",a[k],k; for(k in s) print "STRATEGY",s[k],k; for(k in u) print "SUBTASK",u[k],k}'"' | sort -k2,2nr | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"action:\")))]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0)p[$2]+=$1; else n[$2]+=-$1} END{for(k in p) printf "%s'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]; for(k in n) if("'!(k in p)) printf "%s'"\\t0\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,n[k],-n[k]}' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k4,4nr
jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"strategy:\")))]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0)p[$2]+=$1; else n[$2]+=-$1} END{for(k in p) printf "%s'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]; for(k in n) if("'!(k in p)) printf "%s'"\\t0\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,n[k],-n[k]}' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k4,4nr
jq -r '.value' samples.jsonl | awk '{if("'$1>0)p+=$1;else n+=-$1}END{print "TOTAL",p,n,p-n}'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"result:\")))]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0)p[$2]+=$1; else n[$2]+=-$1} END{for(k in p) printf "%s'"\\t%d\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,p[k],n[k],p[k]-n[k]; for(k in n) if("'!(k in p)) printf "%s'"\\t0\\t%d\\t%d\\n\",k,n[k],-n[k]}' | sort -t "'$'"'\\t' -k4,4nr
jq -r 'select(any(.stack_frames[]; .==\"strategy:inspect\" or .==\"strategy:navigate\")) | [.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"strategy:\")))]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0)p[$2]+=$1;else n[$2]+=-$1} END{for(k in p) printf "%s %d %d %.2f'"\\n\", k,p[k],n[k],p[k]/n[k]}'"
